translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 三階九列，二十七大夫，八十一元士，斗、衡、太微、摄提之屬。
translationRepairDecisions.before: Such are the triple steps, nine columns, twenty-seven senior officials, eighty-one junior gentlemen, the Dipper, the crossbar, the Supreme Palace Enclosure, Jupiter’s “grasping” lodges, and their kind.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Such are the triple steps, nine columns, twenty-seven senior officials, eighty-one junior gentlemen, the Dipper, the crossbar, the Supreme Palace Enclosure, the Sheti (“Grasping”) asterism, and their kind.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 摄提 is the Sheti asterism with 斗、衡、太微, not Jupiter's lodges.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 三階九列，二十七大夫，八十一元士，斗、衡、太微、摄提之屬。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 至漢興，景、武之際，司馬談，談子遷，以世黎氏之后，為太史令，遷著《史记》，作《天官書》。
translationRepairDecisions.before: When Han rose, in the reigns of Jing and Wu, Sima Tan and his son Qian—descendants by marriage of the Li clan—held the post of Grand Astrologer; Qian wrote the Records and composed the Treatise on Celestial Offices.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: When Han rose, in the reigns of Jing and Wu, Sima Tan and his son Qian—hereditary descendants of the Li clan—held the post of Grand Astrologer; Qian wrote the Records and composed the Treatise on Celestial Offices.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 以世黎氏之后 is hereditary Li-clan descent, not marriage.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 至漢興，景、武之際，司馬談，談子遷，以世黎氏之后，為太史令，遷著《史记》，作《天官書》。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 至漢興，景、武之際，司馬談，談子遷，以世黎氏之后，為太史令，遷著《史记》，作《天官書》。
translationRepairDecisions.before: When Han arose, in the time of Jing and Wu, there were Sima Tan and Tan's son Qian; as descendants by marriage of the Li clan, they served as Grand Astrologer; Qian wrote the Records of the Grand Historian and composed the Treatise on the Celestial Offices.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: When Han arose, in the time of Jing and Wu, there were Sima Tan and Tan's son Qian; as hereditary descendants of the Li clan, they served as Grand Astrologer; Qian wrote the Records of the Grand Historian and composed the Treatise on the Celestial Offices.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: Same 以世黎氏之后 for literal.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 至漢興，景、武之際，司馬談，談子遷，以世黎氏之后，為太史令，遷著《史记》，作《天官書》。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 其後有馮焉者。
translationRepairDecisions.before: Later there was a man named Feng.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Later there were those who drew upon it.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 其後有馮焉者 bridges moon-rabbit lore to Chang'e; 冯 read 凭 rely on, not personal name Feng.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 其後有馮焉者。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 其後有馮焉者。
translationRepairDecisions.before: Later there was one named Feng.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Later there were those who relied upon it.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: Paired literal for s0288.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 其後有馮焉者。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 將往，枚筮之於有黃，有黃占之曰：『吉。
translationRepairDecisions.before: Before she went, she had Mei divined with You Huang, who read the omen: 'Auspicious.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Before she went, she had You Huang divine for her with stalks, and he read the omen: 'Auspicious.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 枚筮 is stalk divination; 有黃 is You Huang the diviner.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 將往，枚筮之於有黃，有黃占之曰：『吉。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 將往，枚筮之於有黃，有黃占之曰：『吉。
translationRepairDecisions.before: About to go, she had Mei divined by You Huang; You Huang divined and said: 'Auspicious.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: About to go, she had it divined with stalks by You Huang; You Huang divined and said: 'Auspicious.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 枚筮 cannot be Mei as a name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 將往，枚筮之於有黃，有黃占之曰：『吉。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 后一年正月，光武起兵舂陵，会下江、新市賊張昂、王常及更始之兵亦至，俱攻破南陽，斬莽前队大夫甄阜、屬正梁丘赐等，殺其士眾數萬人。
translationRepairDecisions.before: Next year’s first month saw Guangwu rise at Chunling while Xinshi and Lower Yang rebels under Zhang Ang and Wang Chang joined Gengshi’s host; together they broke Nanyang, cut down Mang’s minister Zhen Fu and Liangqiu Ci, and slaughtered tens of thousands.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Next year’s first month saw Guangwu rise at Chunling while Xinshi and Xiajiang (Lower River) rebels under Zhang Ang and Wang Chang joined Gengshi’s host; together they broke Nanyang, cut down Mang’s minister Zhen Fu and Liangqiu Ci, and slaughtered tens of thousands.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 下江 is Xiajiang rebel band with 新市.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 后一年正月，光武起兵舂陵，会下江、新市賊張昂、王常及更始之兵亦至，俱攻破南陽，斬莽前队大夫甄阜、屬正梁丘赐等，殺其士眾數萬人。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 十月戊申，漢兵自宣平城門入。
translationRepairDecisions.before: Tenth month, day wushen: Han troops poured in through Xuanyping Gate.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Tenth month, day wushen: Han troops poured in through Xuanping Gate.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 宣平城門 is Xuanping Gate spelling.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 十月戊申，漢兵自宣平城門入。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 是時郭后已失勢見疏，后廢為中山太后，陰貴人立為皇后。
translationRepairDecisions.before: Empress Guo was already estranged; soon she became dowager of Zhongshan as Honored Lady Yin ascended the throne.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Empress Guo was already estranged; soon she became dowager of Zhongshan as Honored Lady Yin was installed as empress.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 陰貴人立為皇后 installs empress, not throne succession.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 是時郭后已失勢見疏，后廢為中山太后，陰貴人立為皇后。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 是時郭皇后已疏，至十七年十月，遂廢為中山太后，立陰貴人為皇后，除宫之象也。
translationRepairDecisions.before: Empress Guo had faded; in year seventeen’s tenth month she became Zhongshan dowager while Lady Yin ascended—the “palace cleared” omen.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Empress Guo had faded; in year seventeen’s tenth month she became Zhongshan dowager while Lady Yin was made empress—the “palace cleared” omen.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: Parallel to s0059.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 是時郭皇后已疏，至十七年十月，遂廢為中山太后，立陰貴人為皇后，除宫之象也。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 太微天子廷，北斗魁主殺。
translationRepairDecisions.before: The Supreme Palace Enclosure is the Son of Heaven’s court; the handle of the Northern Dipper presides over executions.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: The Supreme Palace Enclosure is the Son of Heaven’s court; the bowl (kui) of the Northern Dipper presides over executions.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 北斗魁 is bowl/kui, not handle.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 太微天子廷，北斗魁主殺。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 星从太微出，抵北斗魁，是天子大使將出，有所伐殺。
translationRepairDecisions.before: A star coming out of the Supreme Palace Enclosure and striking the Dipper’s handle means a great imperial envoy will go forth to inflict punishment and death.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: A star coming out of the Supreme Palace Enclosure and striking the Dipper’s bowl (kui) means a great imperial envoy will go forth to inflict punishment and death.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 抵北斗魁 targets bowl.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 星从太微出，抵北斗魁，是天子大使將出，有所伐殺。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 是時光武帝使大司馬吴漢发南陽卒三萬人，乘船溯江而上，擊蜀白帝公孫述。
translationRepairDecisions.before: Guangwu then told Wu Han to raise thirty thousand Nanyang troops, row upstream, and attack Gongsun Shu at White Emperor.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Guangwu then told Wu Han to raise thirty thousand Nanyang troops, row upstream, and attack Gongsun Shu, the self-styled White Emperor of Shu.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 蜀白帝公孫述 is self-styled White Emperor of Shu.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 是時光武帝使大司馬吴漢发南陽卒三萬人，乘船溯江而上，擊蜀白帝公孫述。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 是時光武帝使大司馬吴漢发南陽卒三萬人，乘船溯江而上，擊蜀白帝公孫述。
translationRepairDecisions.before: At that time Emperor Guangwu ordered Grand Marshal Wu Han to levy thirty thousand men from Nanyang, sail boats up the Yangzi, and strike Shu’s lord Gongsun Shu at Baidi.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: At that time Emperor Guangwu ordered Grand Marshal Wu Han to levy thirty thousand men from Nanyang, sail boats up the Yangzi, and strike Gongsun Shu, the White Emperor of Shu.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: Same apposition for literal.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 是時光武帝使大司馬吴漢发南陽卒三萬人，乘船溯江而上，擊蜀白帝公孫述。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 十二年十月，漢进兵擊述从弟卫尉永，遂至广都，殺述女婿史興。
translationRepairDecisions.before: Twelfth year, tenth month: Han pushed against Shu’s captain Yong, reached Guangdu, and killed Shi Xing.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Twelfth year, tenth month: Han pushed against Shu’s younger cousin Yong, Commandant of the Guards, reached Guangdu, and killed Shi Xing.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 述从弟卫尉永 is younger cousin Yong, Commandant of Guards.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 十二年十月，漢进兵擊述从弟卫尉永，遂至广都，殺述女婿史興。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 威虏將軍冯骏拔江州，斬述將田戎。
translationRepairDecisions.before: Feng Jun Who Inspires Awe seized Jiangzhou and cut down Tian Rong.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Feng Jun, General Who Awes the Caitiffs, seized Jiangzhou and cut down Tian Rong.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 威虏將軍 is title General Who Awes the Caitiffs; 冯骏 is Feng Jun.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 威虏將軍冯骏拔江州，斬述將田戎。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 臧宫破涪，殺述弟大司空恢。
translationRepairDecisions.before: Zang Gong stormed Fuling and slew Shu’s brother, Grand Minister of Works Hui.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Zang Gong stormed Fu and slew Shu’s brother, Grand Minister of Works Hui.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 破涪 is Fu, not Fuling.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 臧宫破涪，殺述弟大司空恢。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 臧宫破涪，殺述弟大司空恢。
translationRepairDecisions.before: Zang Gong broke Fuling and killed Shu’s younger brother, grand minister of works Hui.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Zang Gong broke Fu and killed Shu’s younger brother, grand minister of works Hui.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: Same 涪 for literal.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 臧宫破涪，殺述弟大司空恢。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 明日，漢入屠蜀城，诛述大將公孫晃、延岑等，所殺數萬人，夷滅述妻宗族萬余人以上。
translationRepairDecisions.before: Next day Han sacked Chengdu, executed Huang, Yan Cen, and other captains, killed tens of thousands, and wiped out over ten thousand of the consort clan.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: Next day Han sacked Chengdu, executed Gongsun Huang, Yan Cen, and other captains, killed tens of thousands, and wiped out over ten thousand of Gongsun Shu's wife's clan.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 公孫晃 is Gongsun Huang; 述妻宗族 is Gongsun Shu's wife's clan.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 明日，漢入屠蜀城，诛述大將公孫晃、延岑等，所殺數萬人，夷滅述妻宗族萬余人以上。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 又七星间有客星，炎二尺所，西南行，至明年二月二十二日，在舆鬼東北六尺所滅，凡見百一十三日。
translationRepairDecisions.before: A stray fire also threaded the Northern Dipper for 113 days, dying northeast of the Ghosts.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: A guest star with a two-foot flame also appeared among the Seven Stars lodge and moved southwest; on the twenty-second day of the next year’s second month it vanished six feet northeast of the Ghosts, after 113 days.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 七星间客星 is guest star among Seven Stars lodge, not Dipper threading.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 又七星间有客星，炎二尺所，西南行，至明年二月二十二日，在舆鬼東北六尺所滅，凡見百一十三日。

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 七星，周地。
translationRepairDecisions.before: The Dipper’s field is Zhou.
translationRepairDecisions.afterApplied: The Seven Stars lodge’s field is Zhou.
translationRepairDecisions.independentReason: 七星，周地 is Seven Stars lodge field for Zhou.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 七星，周地。
